summary: Five queryable Calcidius records presented English placeholders as original Latin, inherited false Plato authorship and stale placeholder metrics, and carried unsupported Academic/Neoplatonist classification. The repaired cohort is the checked CHMTL transcription of Wrobel 1876 sections 142-146 under CTS stoa0071b.stoa001, visually collated at printed pages 202-205/PDF pages 231-234. DLT000070 and DLT000607 are both Calcidius catalog/edition records; neither is the provenance identity of this CHMTL/Wrobel manifestation.
resolution_criteria: Adjudicated at sections 142-146: source bytes, texts, chapter cuts, v/u spelling, Wrobel page map, CTS/work identity, distinct DigilibLT records, exact snapshots, sole Calcidius authorship and cautious date/religion/school metadata are regression-tested.

adjudication.decision: Use CTS work urn:cts:latinLit:stoa0071b.stoa001 and the CHMTL/Wrobel manifestation for sections 142-146; represent DLT000070 and DLT000607 as distinct external Calcidius records, remove false Plato/school edges, and make no categorical religious or exact-school claim.
adjudication.rationale: The pinned Wayback HTML re-download matches SHA-256 2a5003ed..., the five section texts and boundaries match Wrobel printed pages 202-205, the Perseus catalog identifies the work/edition URNs, and independent edge/manifest review exposed and corrected the remaining provenance errors.
